response.overview: As part of a school project, Rachel begins investigating the fifty-year-old murder of infamous paranormal investigator Lucy Carter, a case the supernatural community has long attributed to an angry spirit. But as Rachel delves deeper into Lucy’s past, long-buried secrets begin to surface, raising questions about what really happened that night.
response.tagline: "We suspect everyone, Rachel. Everyone is guilty of something."
response.title: A Ghost at Gilmore House
